title: Graphene oxide composited with nano-Fe3O4 for enhancing root reducibility in ryegrass (Lolium perenne L.)
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,3669-3680
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01227E, Paper
Wenwen Li, Ruoyao Shen, Yi Zhang, Yu Ran, Wenbin Yang, Shiyong Yang
GO/Fe3O4 provided Fe nutrient for ryegrass and promoted root reducibility. However, high GO/Fe3O4 inhibited ryegrass growth and damaged the cell membrane. These effects were also verified by gene expression related to proline and the GSH–ASA cycle.
